title: EXPORT MARKETING & DOCUMENTATION EXECUTIVE
description:
WE ARE HIRING!

EXPORT MARKETING & DOCUMENTATION EXECUTIVE

GOURIKA INDIA LIMITED

Drive International Sales. Master Export Documentation. Build Global Business Relationships.

GOURIKA INDIA LIMITED is looking for a dynamic, dedicated, and result-oriented Export Marketing & Documentation Executive to strengthen our international business operations and expand our presence in global markets.

We are looking for a professional who possesses a strong understanding of export marketing, international business development, and end-to-end export documentation. The ideal candidate should be capable of developing overseas customers, handling export inquiries, coordinating shipments, and ensuring accurate and timely completion of all export-related documents.

Key Responsibilities

Export Marketing & Business Development

\* Identify and develop new international markets, overseas buyers, importers, and distributors.

\* Generate export leads, handle inquiries, prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and follow up with prospective customers.

\* Develop long-term business relationships with international clients.

\* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer development activities.

\* Achieve export sales targets and contribute to the company’s international business growth.

Export Documentation & Shipment Coordination

\* Prepare, verify, and maintain export documents, including Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Shipping Bills, Certificates of Origin, and other applicable export documents.

\* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers (CHAs), shipping lines, banks, and other relevant agencies.

\* Handle shipping instructions, bill of lading coordination, and shipment tracking.

\* Maintain knowledge of Letter of Credit (LC), bank documentation, and export payment procedures.

\* Coordinate with relevant authorities and service providers for applicable certificates, regulatory requirements, and customs clearance.

\* Ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely submission of export documentation in accordance with applicable regulations and customer requirements.

\* Maintain proper records of export orders, shipments, and documentation.

Candidate Requirements

\* Previous experience in export marketing, international sales, and export documentation will be preferred.

\* Practical knowledge of export procedures, shipping documentation, customs clearance, and international trade terms (Incoterms).

\* Familiarity with export payment terms, LC documentation, and banking procedures.

\* Excellent communication, negotiation, coordination, and follow-up skills.

\* Proficiency in MS Office, email correspondence, and preparation of commercial documents.

\* A proactive, organized, and detail-oriented professional with a strong sense of responsibility.

Join Our Team!

If you have the right combination of export marketing skills, documentation expertise, and a passion for international business, this is an excellent opportunity to grow with GOURIKA INDIA LIMITED and contribute to our global expansion.
